name: Duke's Reincarnation
author: Kainatic
bootlegger: Duchess: Each day, 3 players may choose to visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 might swap alignment.
If less than 3 players choose to visit the Duchess, a player might die at night*.
If more than 3 players choose to visit the Duchess, the selection is arbitrary.
If a Demon swaps alignment, they become a not-in-play good character. If no Demon remains in-play, an evil player becomes the new Demon.
